The paper reports one experiment, a 2 x 2 between-subjects design. Every similarity, classifier, type-token, grammar and content analysis reuses the same 118 people, and the form codes them all as outcomes of one study (S1), so no person is counted twice.

summary: The PDF supports every participant count in the c026 form: 118 Prolific workers were analyzed (Table 1: 24 and 29 without AI, 36 and 29 with AI; 60 India and 58 US), the counts are people, every printed df and effect size reproduces from those arm sizes with four essays each, no count at assignment is printed so null n_randomized is right, no other study or paper shares the sample, and S1 alone clears 50 people. The coding is refuted only on details of the exclusions record: it says US recruitment 'matched the Indian count' although the paper's own counts are 60 vs 58 and the 2-person gap goes unflagged, and it omits the completion requirement (tasks plus post-task survey) as a second unreported route for loss after assignment.
